UX Designer - Dados - Híbrido em Campinas

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenhar a experiência e arquitetura visual de dashboards executivos, com foco em métricas / indicadores de performance digital. O objetivo é transformar dados quantitativos complexos em interfaces executivas claras, consistentes e orientadas à tomada de decisão.

A atuação será em interface direta com analistas de dados e cientistas de mídia, exigindo alta capacidade de abstração, síntese e pensamento sistêmico aplicado à visualização de informações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Mapeamento de necessidades executivas: entender os indicadores-chave de negócio (KPI e OKR) e traduzi-los em fluxos e layouts de visualização.
  • Arquitetura de informação aplicada a dados: organizar painéis complexos em camadas de contexto, relevância e storytelling visual.
  • Design de dashboards em Figma: criação de sistemas visuais escaláveis, uso avançado de auto‑layout, componentes e tokens de design.
  • Modelagem de hierarquia e densidade informacional: priorizar leitura, escaneabilidade e clareza executiva em painéis de alto nível.
  • Interlocução com times de dados: validação de métricas, naming conventions, KPIs e estrutura lógica de agrupamentos.
  • Documentação técnica: padronizar o sistema visual e garantir rastreabilidade e consistência entre dashboards e apresentações executivas.
  • Storytelling de dados: estruturar narrativas visuais que permitam interpretação rápida e contextualização estratégica, boas práticas de visualização de dados também.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em UX Design voltado a Data Visualization / Dashboards / BI Interfaces.
  • Domínio avançado de Figma (componentização, grid systems, prototipação e documentação).
  • Inglês fluente para lidar com documentação técnica e stakeholders internacionais.
  • Familiaridade com métricas de mídia, social e performance digital (alcance, engajamento, CPM, CTR, share of voice, sentiment, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em design de informação, usabilidade aplicada a dados e storytelling analítico.
  • Capacidade analítica para ler e estruturar dados numéricos com coerência visual e semântica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau ou similares).
  • Vivência com data storytelling, service design ou inteligência de negócios.
  • Experiência anterior em contextos corporativos complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders executivos.

É importante que o profissional tenha

Raciocínio lógico e sensibilidade visual, capaz de conectar usabilidade, dados e narrativa executiva. Autonomia técnica, comunicação assertiva em inglês e domínio de ferramentas de design e dados.

Informações adicionais

Contratação em modelo PJ com benefícios. Atuação direta com times globais, proporcionando trocas riquíssimas. Ambiente acelerado com muitas oportunidades de crescimento. Atuação híbrida em Campinas.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Toradex is a leading provider of embedded computing solutions, specializing in powerful, reliable, and easy-to-use hardware and software for IoT , industrial automation, medical devices, and other verticals. With a focus on high-quality, reliability, ease-of-use, and a strong developer experience, Toradex offers a range of System on Modules (SoMs), accompanying accessories and carrier boards, customization services, a full-stack software offering facilitating cyber regulations compliance, and much more. Headquartered in Switzerland, with offices across the globe, Toradex is committed to empowering developers and businesses by delivering innovative, high-quality solutions that reduce complexity and accelerate time to market.

Job Description

As a Product Marketing Manager at Toradex, you will play a key role in shaping how the market perceives our cutting-edge embedded computing solutions. You’ll lead initiatives to build awareness and drive adoption by combining strategic product positioning with creative storytelling. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Design, you will help to execute go-to-market strategies, craft clear and differentiated messaging, and collaborate to translate complex technical capabilities into compelling narratives and impactful campaigns. This role blends analytical thinking and creative vision, requiring the ability to connect engineering depth with market relevance, as well as the skill to develop high-performing content that drives awareness, engagement, and growth across multiple channels.

Goals

Drive awareness and accelerate adoption of Toradex products by shaping market perception, building strong narratives, and ensuring consistent, impactful communication across all touchpoints, from technical storytelling to creative execution.

How

  • Efficiently sharing positioning and messaging for new Toradex products and aligning the company and customers around that.
  • Creating narratives that communicate the value and differentiation of our products to developers, engineers, and decision-makers.
  • Partnering closely with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation and Design to translate technical capabilities into compelling stories.
  • Ensuring messaging consistency across website, campaigns, events, and collateral.
  • Monitoring and analyzing marketing performance to continuously refine both positioning and creative execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Helping to create a clear and differentiated product story that resonates with target audiences and aligns internal teams on the “why” behind our products.
  • Content Creation: Act as aCreative Strategist, translating product messaging into creative concepts and storytelling frameworks. Create copy for key assets such as product pages, digital ads, launch materials, presentations, blogs, and videos to drive awareness of new products and features across different audiences and channels.
  • Go-to-Market Support: Collaborate on product launches by defining messaging frameworks, coordinating enablement materials, and ensuring cross-team alignment.
  • Campaign Collaboration: Partner with Paid Media, Social, Product Marketing, and Designteams to align messaging, visuals, and campaign objectives and to ensure campaigns accurately reflect product positioning and market insights.
  • Market Feedback Loop: Gather insights from campaigns and customers to refine messaging and guide content priorities.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Product, Sales, and Demand Generation to ensure GTM alignment and consistency across regions and verticals.

Desired Candidate Profile

Must Have:

  • Between 3 to 5 years of professional experience in Product Marketing, Marketing Management, or Creative Strategy within a technology or B2B context
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a proven background working with technical products
  • Strong English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Understanding of B2B technology marketing in global markets
  • Proven ability to create content for both technical and business audiences
  • Experience crafting ad copy, creative concepts, and performance-driven campaigns for both awareness and lead generation
  • Understands paid marketing and social media dynamics, and how to adapt creative to maximize reach and engagement across platforms
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to measure and iterate on marketing effectiveness
  • Collaborative working style, comfortable coordinating across multiple teams and functions
  • Passionate and enthusiastic about talking about new, cutting-edge technology devices
  • Proven ability to lead by influence

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in Toradex’s target verticals such as Healthcare, Industrial Automation, Transportation, Smart City, or Test & Measurement
  • Familiarity with Embedded Systems or related hardware/software technologies

What we offer

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Why Soben? We´re an award-winning construction consultancy with bold ambitions and a clear vision for the future. Since our founding in 2011, we've made significant progress, but now, we’re entering a new chapter of accelerated growth and transformation.

Role Description We are seeking a Commissioning Manager to support critical data center projects in the São Paulo–Campinas region. In this role, you will work closely with commissioning teams, architects, engineers, construction managers, network and operations teams, and finance partners to streamline the delivery of new data center capacity. You will drive execution across scope, schedule, and budget, ensuring all projects are commissioned to the owner’s standards and transitioned smoothly into operation.

  • Serve as the primary on-site Commissioning Manager for assigned data center projects.
  • Report commissioning progress, risks, and KPIs to Regional and Director-level leadership.

  • Oversee and manage contracted Commissioning Agents to ensure performance and compliance.
  • Conduct regular construction site inspections to assess QA/QC, commissioning status, and safety considerations.

  • Coordinate with clients, partners, and vendor Project Managers to align scope, schedule, and budget.

  • Manage and update the commissioning schedule to ensure project milestones are met.
  • Support strategy development and continuous improvement of commissioning policies and methodologies.
  • Ensure contract compliance and performance oversight for all vendors involved in commissioning activities.
  • Maintain full on-site presence, including Saturdays during critical commissioning phases, with minimal travel.

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field AND 2+ years Commissioning Management or relevant technical engineering experience
  • 2+ years of experience in datacenter facilities (maintenance, operations, construction, commissioning)
  • 2+ years of construction experience with new build/greenfield projects
  • 2+ years of experience with electrical and mechanical test equipment

Preferred/Additional Qualifications

  • Prior experience with construction QA/QC, and project management
  • Knowledge in datacenter commissioning, as well as datacenter operations and maintenance
  • Understanding of Uninterruptible Power Systems (UPS) systems, switchgears, generators, and critical mechanical systems
  • Prior experience writing Commissioning Scripts
  • Experience with issue identification and resolution management
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and MS Project

Sobre ATACADÃO

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.

Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

Introduction

Are you passionate about driving digital transformation in field service operations in a global environment? Do you have excellent technical skills—especially with SAP ECC CS and ideally SAP S/4HANA Service? We are seeking a hands-on Implementation Manager with deep SAP expertise to lead and deliver projects as part of our Global Technical Operations Team. Join us and shape our field service ecosystem, optimizing business processes, and ensuring technical excellence across our organization.

Your Responsibilities

  • Project Leadership: Independently manage and deliver complex implementation projects for our SAP-integrated Field Service Management system—from requirements engineering and solution design to Go-Live.
  • Technical System Configuration & Assessment: Utilize your expertise in SAP ECC CS and S/4HANA Service to evaluate available configuration options, enhancement frameworks (e.g., ABAP, User Exits, BADIs, RICEFW), and integration touchpoints with external Field Service Management platforms. Collaborate with IT and development teams to translate functional needs into robust technical system configurations, while adhering to established system capabilities and governance frameworks ensuring optimal alignment with business requirements and technical standards.
  • Interface & Integration Management: Analyze, design, and optimize interfaces between SAP modules (ECC CS, SD, S/4HANA Service) and third-party applications, ensuring robust system communication and data flows (IDOCs).
  • Process Optimization: Analyze and document business processes and technical workflows, focusing on automation, data quality, and system efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborate closely with both business and IT stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical solutions and acting as a technical consultant and change manager.
  • Data Quality & Business Intelligence: Develop, maintain, and optimize reporting solutions and analytics, ensuring high data consistency and reliability.
  • Training & Support: Deliver technical trainings, create documentation, and provide expert support to users and project teams.
  • Lifecycle Management: Support application lifecycle including 2nd level support.

Your Profile

  • 4-6 years of hands‑on experience with SAP ECC CS module and ideally SAP S/4HANA Service, including Customizing, technical configuration, and enhancement technologies (e.g., ABAP, BADIs, User Exits).
  • Deep understanding of SAP integration concepts (IDoc, RFC, Web Services, APIs) and experience in connecting SAP with external systems.
  • Proven track record in technical project management especially in IT/business process implementation projects.
  • Strong experience in interface design, data modelling, and system troubleshooting.
  • High attention to detail and passion for data quality.

Additional Skills

  • Hands‑on mentality, high IT affinity and willingness to learn about new IT systems, especially in the field of cloud and mobile applications.
  • Assertive and confident in technical discussions and decision‑making.
  • Team player with excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, as required.
  • Knowledge in SQL, SAP Field Service Management and Jira considered as a plus.
  • Fluent in English (Spanish is a plus).

Education

  • University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience.

Our Offer

There is a lot for you to discover at Fresenius Medical Care, because we have a lot to offer. No matter in which field you are an expert and how much experience you bring with you - for your professional future with meaning:

  • The opportunity to shape the future of healthcare innovation at a global market leader.
  • A highly collaborative, mission‑driven, and innovative culture.
  • Global exposure, challenging assignments, and high visibility.
  • A platform to make a tangible impact in advancing health, sustainability, and innovation.

At Fresenius Medical Care , we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high‑quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision —“ Creating a future worth living . For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life‑sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our values guide how we work:

  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user-centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end-users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

description:
HR Operations Specialist – French & Spanish (f/m/d)

  • You are part of our HR Operations team, who is the first point of contact for our employees for questions on all HR-related topics as well as system support.
  • You take care of our employees’ HR related concerns via ticket system, chat and calls and, if necessary, forward them to the responsible department.
  • You advise on HR processes and ensure that the HR policies are adhered to.
  • In addition to GEA employees and managers, your stakeholders are also your colleagues from HR Operations and the local HR Business Partners.
  • You adequately maintain employee data in our HRM systems (Workday, Service Now and SAP).
  • With great care you also create various documents, such as certificates, job references or congratulatory letters.
  • Together with your team, you will ensure standardized processes – we live and breathe best practice sharing and are looking for people who are keen to continuously optimize these processes.
  • You completed business studies with a focus on human resources and/or have hands‑on experience and training in the field of human resources.
  • In your way of working, you are solution‑oriented, you are able to organize yourself well, you like to support team-internal questions and you love the challenge to solve difficult cases and practice knowledge sharing.
  • Communication and customer orientation are your top skills.
  • You feel at home in an administrative environment and because you are PC‑savvy, you can quickly familiarize yourself with our systems or ideally have experience in Workday, Service Now as well as the common MS Office tools.
  • We expect you to be fluent in written and spoken French & Spanish; in addition, you should be fluent in English so that you feel at home in the international GEA environment.

What We Offer

  • International team based in the heart of Berlin‑Mitte
  • Insight into the dynamic world of an HR Shared Service Center
  • 30 days of vacation
  • Flexible home office policy / Hybrid
  • Monthly Lieferando food Voucher
  • Monthly BVG subsidy support
  • In addition to the home office option, your workplace is part of Pressehaus Podium (from October)

About GEA

About the Company: GEA is an international engineering company and one of the largest suppliers for the food, beverage, chemical, pharmaceutical and farm technology industries. In fact, without realizing it, you have likely eaten, drunk or taken medication produced with GEA technology.
